text:
lara: FYI — we need a short migration note and a minimal snippet for the v1->v2 API change. deadline: two weeks. primary ask: clarify model swap behavior when embedding dims change and show a safe fallback snippet.
priya: +1. can we keep it super short — one page with a TL;DR and two examples (TS + Python)? :thumbsup:
sam: I can do the SDK snippet toggles. quick Q: do we want to mention the alias map or recommend using explicit model IDs?
alex: recommend explicit IDs for critical workloads. alias map note as optional. we should show how fallback to the older model happens in practice.
joel: Product asks for a single line about user-facing impact: "embedding vectors may change length after model swap; reindexing required". keep that copy for the migration banner.
lara: good. priya — can you own the TL;DR and banner copy? sam — SDK snippets (TS + py). riley — can you review?
priya: I got the banner. draft: "Deprecated: /v1/models will be removed on 2026-04-15. If you swap embedding models, vector dimensions may change; reindex before swapping in production."
riley: looks fine. suggest adding link to reindex guide.
maya: need heads up for localization — will need strings by 2026-03-31 if we want translations ready.
sam: putting together TS snippet, want to show graceful fallback. sketch:
```ts
// Try v2 embed, fall back to v1-compat model if dims mismatch
const m = await client.models.get('my-embed-v2');
const dims = await client.models.getEmbeddingDim(m.id);
if (dims !== EXPECTED_DIM) {
  // fallback
  const useModel = 'my-embed-v1';
  await client.embed({ model: useModel, input });
} else {
  await client.embed({ model: m.id, input });
}
```
joel: maybe shorten — readers don't want lots of API calls. show high-level pattern then link to samples repo.
sam: agreed. will compress + link. also add a note for batching caveats when dims change.
priya: I'll draft the page structure:
- TL;DR banner (1 line)
- What changes (bullets)
- Quick migration steps (1-2)
- Code snippets (TS + Python)
- Smoke tests + reindex checklist
- Links + PR checklist
lara: perfect. add a short checklist for docs reviewers and owning teams.
riley: pinging @alex for model behavior confirmation — does runtime auto-fallback ever convert vectors, or is reindexing required?
alex: runtime does NOT auto-convert vector dims. if you swap to a model with different embed dim, embeddings are incompatible. Reindex or keep previous model alias pinned.
priya: ok adding that line. also adding recommended rollout steps: canary reindex -> compare dot-prod -> full swap.
docs-bot: Reminder: please add the migration doc to the "deprecations" sidebar and file an Issues label: docs-migration.
lara: assigned PR owner: @sam. target PR branch: docs/migration/embed-dim-fallback. PR checklist: include link fixes, snippet smoke tests, and localization stub.
sam: will open PR tomorrow. small ask: can someone run the TS snippet smoke test in node 18? I can run py locally.
riley: I can run node test. please add a tiny test harness in the PR to validate snippet output shape.
maya: localization note — please mark strings with i18n keys and provide source text in the PR description.
joel: one more user-facing line: "We recommend pinning model IDs in production to avoid surprises during model swaps." add that to TL;DR.
priya: drafting PR description and the banner copy now. will share in thread when ready.
lara: timeline: draft by EOD tomorrow, review by riley/alex within 48h, merge by 2026-03-25 to allow localization. everyone ok?
sam: yep.
riley: yep.
alex: good.
priya: posting draft in thread in ~2h.
priya: DRAFT (paste):
"Two-week deprecation notice: /v1/models will be retired on 2026-04-15. If you update embedding models, vector dimensions may change — you must reindex or pin the previous model to preserve search vectors. See migration steps and snippets below"
lara: looks good. minor edit: replace 'must' with 'should' to soften tone.
priya: updated.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4212 (WIP) — includes compact TS + Python snippets, a smoke test, and checklist.
riley: reviewing now. small nits: shorten inline comment in TS, and add `EXPECTED_DIM` comment. also fix lint warnings.
sam: fixing.
priya: localization stub added to PR description.
maya: got it. will queue translation if merged by 3/31.
lara: thank you all. quick follow-up: can we include a one-liner for SDK breaking change (param rename) in the migration doc? it's low risk but confusing.
riley: yes — put it in "What changed" bullets: param `embed_model` -> `model_id` example.
priya: added bullet and example mapping line.
joel: great. after merge, we'll send an in-product banner and a support note.
lara: wrap-up: sam to finish snippet polish + tests; priya to finish TL;DR and PR text; riley + alex review; maya handle localization timing. I'll post a final reminder 48h before merge.
priya: thanks!
sam: pushing final commit now. :shipit:
